attributes.title: Denied actions - policy decision inputs
attributes.description: Valid denied actions with target, actor, policy, identity, provenance, and quality context for a separately governed policy engine.

attributes.title: Policy Advisor proposals and reconciled draft chunks
attributes.description: Latest Policy Advisor proposal evidence from OCSF and read-only draft reconciliation. Preserve the chunk ID and evidence ID when handing off to a separate policy engine.

attributes.title: OpenShell - Policy Engine Evidence Workbench
attributes.description: SOC-to-policy-engine handoff: review denied actions, the latest real Policy Advisor proposal, authoritative policy context, identifiers, and full evidence provenance.
